summary_en: 3,279,799 shares (59.6% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) tendered and accepted by Yamatake Sogyō in public tender offer (April 30–June 15, 2026). Tender price ¥2,356/share; total acquisition value ¥7.725B. Yamatake shareholding rises from 35.56% to 95.19% upon settlement June 22. Board recommended the offer. Squeeze-out via second-stage transaction planned post-settlement.
title_en: Notice of Results of Public Tender Offer for Shinpo Co., Ltd. Shares by Yamatake Sogyō Co., Ltd. and Change in Parent Company
translation_en_brief: Yamatake Sogyō Co., Ltd. (a private company controlled by Yamada Kiyohisa, who also serves as a Shinpo director) conducted a public tender offer for all ordinary shares of Shinpo from April 30 to June 15, 2026. The offer succeeded: 3,279,799 shares were tendered, exceeding the minimum acceptance threshold of 1,710,950 shares. At ¥2,356 per share, the total acquisition value is approximately ¥7.725 billion. Upon settlement on June 22, 2026, Yamatake's voting rights will increase from 35.56% to 95.19%, making it Shinpo's parent company. The Shinpo board recommended shareholders accept the offer. The disclosure indicates that Yamatake intends to execute a second-stage acquisition (squeeze-out transaction) to acquire the remaining shares not tendered, though the structure and timing are not detailed in this excerpt.
